chunks: He said: Abul Hasan Muhammad ibn Ja'far reported to me, saying: Hisham narrated to us, saying: Yahya ibn Ya'la narrated to me, from Humaid, from Abdullah ibn al-Harith, from Abdullah ibn Masood, who said: The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and his family and grant him peace, said:

"Those who love each other for the sake of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, shall be upon pillars of red ruby in Paradise, overlooking the people of Paradise. Whenever one of them appears, his beauty fills the houses of the people of Paradise. Then the people of Paradise say: Come out, let us behold those who love each other for the sake of Allah, Mighty and Majestic. He said: So they come out and gaze upon them. One of them has a face like the full moon on a moonlit night. Upon their foreheads is written: These are those who love each other for the sake of Allah, Mighty and Majestic."

key_terms.المتحابون في الله: Those who love each other for the sake of Allah — refers to sincere friendships formed purely for divine pleasure, not worldly benefit
key_terms.عز وجل: Mighty and Majestic — an honorific formula for Allah
key_terms.ياقوت أحمر: Red ruby — symbolizing the precious and luminous nature of their reward in Paradise

ai.seo_question: What is the reward in Paradise for those who love each other for the sake of Allah?
ai.summary: This prophetic tradition describes the exalted status in Paradise of those who love each other for the sake of Allah. The Prophet (SAWW) narrated to his companions that such people will occupy pillars of red ruby, with radiant beauty visible to all inhabitants of Paradise. The hadith was transmitted through Abdullah ibn Masood, one of the earliest and most prominent companions, emphasizing the immense spiritual reward for sincere bonds of friendship formed purely for God's pleasure.
